notes: Roots arcing out of the ground and back under it, with no trunk — the thing that appears where a slope has eroded away from a tree. The underground half is generated and never drawn; the arcs end below y = 0 so the terrain cuts them off instead of leaving them stopped in mid-air. Deliberately NOT solid: ankle-high sprawling scenery the player cannot read as an obstacle is the worst thing to be stopped by.

rules.placement: Eroded slope roots with no trunk — ankle-high non-solid scenery where soil has washed from trees.
rules.avoid: Avoid desert, coast, and open meadow — needs eroded forest / alpine slopes.
